summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Nomura Holdings, Inc., a foreign private issuer, reporting its quarterly financial summary (U.S. GAAP) for the three months ended June 30, 2026. It includes consolidated operating results, financial position, dividend information, and no earnings forecasts. The filing contains no announcement of any M&A, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return program, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change. It is a standard periodic report incorporated by reference into existing shelf registration statements. No special-situation corporate event is disclosed.
